drawings.description: dessin : un triangle aux trois sommets marqués d'un point, coupé par un arc joignant les deux sommets de la base, avec une petite croix au milieu de la base
drawings.notes: Triangle with its three vertices marked by dots, cut by an arc joining the two base vertices, and a small cross in the middle of the base. The two small drawings above it on the page (with "ou") are covered by a note of the transcription, not by this mark.

drawings.description: schéma de sa main en haut de la page, sans texte qui l'introduise ; les traits se terminent par un petit crochet, rendu par des flèches à crochet dans le sens où ils sont tracés. Il se rapporte à la Proposition de la page 16, où $L = F.G$
drawings.notes: Omb F and Omb G above, Omb(F) cap Omb(G) in the middle, Omb(L) below; three strokes, each ending in his small hook, drawn as on the page.

drawings.description: schéma d'inclusions tracé par simples traits ; un premier « $\mathrm{omb}(Y)$ » est biffé et récrit à côté
drawings.notes: omb(X) and omb(Y) above, omb(X) cap omb(Y), omb(L) below, joined by plain strokes. Omitted as struck: the first omb(Y), struck through on the page and rewritten to its right. The formulas in the upper part of the crop are not part of the drawing and are left out. Issue 128, 2026-11-09: struck material left out after a fresh check of the facsimile (struck-out material is not drawn). Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: sous cette ligne biffée, un croquis : une droite portant, de gauche à droite, un segment subdivisé en deux, un point isolé, un segment, deux points, un segment plus long subdivisé, un segment finement subdivisé, un point — une figure finie de l'exemple
drawings.notes: Encoded as segment-config/1 (points a..r left to right; "bracket" = an end or subdivision tick, "isolated" = a 0-stratum alone), re-read on a wider crop. Left to right: a segment subdivided in three (a-b-c-d: the mark near its right end, not encoded before, is a clear cross tick like the others), an isolated point e, a segment f-g, two points h, i, a longer segment subdivided in two (j-k-l), a finely subdivided segment (m..q, four pieces: five ticks), a point r. The line itself is not drawn by him: the pieces are separate. Disagreement: the transcription says the first segment is subdivided in two; on the crop it has two interior ticks, so three pieces. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (page): the first segment carries four ticks, its two ends and two between them, so it is cut in three pieces, as encoded; the transcription's « subdivisé en deux » is a miscount. Not checked by a reader.
drawings.disagreement: The transcription's « un segment subdivisé en deux » (the first one): on the crop it carries two interior ticks, i.e. three pieces.

drawings.description: dessin : un fuseau fermé, deux arcs joignant un point marqué $0$ à gauche à un point marqué $1$ à droite ; une croix $x$ sur l'arc supérieur ; à côté, « (\uncertain{saisons} \ill{}) » ; sous le dessin, « (un \ill{} $x$ de $]0,1[$) »
drawings.notes: Redrawn on a tight crop. Closed spindle: two arcs from the point 0 (left) to the point 1 (right), both ending on the same two computed points; the cross on the upper arc (it carries no separate letter x above it: the x of the transcription is the cross itself; the raised x at the right of the lower arc belongs to the legend). The legend under the drawing is written as the transcription reads it. Left out: the legend on the right ("(saisons ...)", partly illegible), the long thin curve from the lower left rising to the right edge under the legend (the oblique marginal note's link), the text lines. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (page): the upper arc carries one small cross and no letter beside it; the other x, by the lower arc, stands in the legend « (un ... x de ]0,1[) ». The cross is the point x, drawn once. Not checked by a reader.

drawings.description: dessin à gauche : un fuseau de $0$ à $1$ ; sur l'arc supérieur les points $x_1$, $(x_3)$, $x_2$, sur l'arc inférieur $x'_2$, $(x'_3)$, $x'_1$ ; les segments $[x_1, x_2]$ et $[x'_2, x'_1]$ sont repassés en gras ; à côté, « $z_1 = (x_1, x'_1)$ », « $z_2 = (x_2, x'_2)$ »
drawings.notes: Spindle from 0 to 1; on the upper arc x_1, (x_3), x_2, on the lower arc x'_2, (x'_3), x'_1; the segments [x_1, x_2] and [x'_2, x'_1] thick; on the left z_1 = (x_1, x'_1), z_2 = (x_2, x'_2). The formula under the drawing belongs to the text.

drawings.description: dessin : une chaîne de quatre sommets reliés $A'$ — $A$ — $B$ — $B'$, des pointillés prolongeant le graphe au-delà de $A'$ et de $B'$
drawings.notes: Chain of four vertices A' - A - B - B'. The dotted continuations are drawn where they stand on the page: two short dashed strokes to the left of A' (one level with the chain, one lower) and a short dash at the right edge, beyond B'. Not encoded: the figure is explicitly a part of a larger graph.

drawings.description: schéma en losange à gauche de la démonstration ; à gauche, « $X'' \in$ » pointe vers $\widetilde{X}'$, à droite « $\ni Y''$ » vers $\widetilde{Y}'$
drawings.notes: Lozenge: X~ and Y~ at the top; X~', L, Y~'; X'_L, Y'_L; L' at the bottom, joined by plain strokes; on the left "X'' in" pointing to X~', on the right "ni Y''" towards Y~' (cut at the crop edge). Strokes placed between the labels; their exact ends are approximate.

drawings.description: dans la note oblique, après « ex : » : un quadrilatère (losange déformé) traversé par une diagonale, du sommet supérieur gauche au sommet inférieur droit ; la diagonale porte deux gros points, et un cercle passe par ces deux points, dont elle est un diamètre ; une petite marque à l'intérieur, à gauche du cercle ; une croix à droite du quadrilatère et une autre au-dessous.
drawings.kind: quadrilateral with a diagonal and a circle (simplicial counter-example)
drawings.notes: In the oblique marginal note, after « ex : »: a quadrilateral (a skew rhombus: top side nearly horizontal, the two long sides slanting down to the left), its diagonal from the upper left vertex to the lower right vertex, two heavy points on that diagonal (computed on it), and a circle through these two points, of which the piece of diagonal between them is a diameter (centre and radius computed from the two points). A cross to the right of the quadrilateral (its upright gone over heavily) and a cross below it. Partial: a small mark inside the quadrilateral, left of the circle (a tick or a tiny letter), is not read and is left out; on the page the bottom side stops just short of the lower right vertex, here it is closed; the page's circle is an irregular oval. The letters « ex : » above are text. Nothing struck. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (page): at 700 dpi the diameter is the quadrilateral's oblique diagonal and there are two crosses outside, one to the right and one below; the small mark inside, left of the circle, is a small cross of two short strokes, now drawn. Not checked by a reader.
drawings.disagreement: The transcription's note says « un cercle coupé par un diamètre vertical, avec de petites croix autour »: the diameter is oblique on the sheet (it is the diagonal of the quadrilateral, which runs on to two of its vertices), and there are two crosses, one to the right and one below.

drawings.description: deux petits dessins séparés par « ou » : à gauche, un triangle dont la base porte deux gros points, joints par un arc intérieur au triangle ; à droite, un triangle aplati, deux gros points aux extrémités de sa base, joints par un arc intérieur qui double la base.
drawings.kind: two small triangles with an inner arc (inclusion of a 1-simplex in a 2-simplex)
drawings.notes: Two small figures on one line, « ou » between them. Left: a triangle whose base runs a little beyond the foot of the left side; two heavy points on the base (computed on it), joined by an arc inside the triangle. Right: a flat triangle, a heavy point at each end of its base, the two points joined by an arc inside the triangle, close to the base. Sides drawn meeting at the vertices (on the page the two upper sides of each triangle leave a hair's gap at the apex). Nothing struck. These two figures stand just above the drawing 01-1 of the same page. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à gauche, sous la formule, trois petits croquis : devant « b) », un segment marqué $X$, son extrémité gauche un gros point que désigne une petite flèche partie de $Y$ ; devant « c) », deux segments séparés marqués $X$ et $Y$, puis « ou », et au-dessous deux segments $X$, $Y$ bout à bout, un gros point à leur extrémité commune.
drawings.kind: segments and points on a line (cases b and c of compatibility)
drawings.notes: Three small sketches at the lower left of the page, illustrating the cases (b) and (c) of the text. After « b) »: a segment labelled X, a heavy point at its left end, to which a short arrow points down from the letter Y; the right end of the segment is thickened. After « c) »: two separate segments labelled X and Y (X with a heavy point at its left end and a tick at its right end, Y with a tick at each end), then « ou » to the right, and below them two segments X, Y end to end, a tick at each outer end and a heavy point at the common end. Labels as on the page. Nothing struck. Not encoded as data (segment-config): the three rows are separate configurations with a text label each; redrawn. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again.

c), second case: segments X, Y end to end

drawings.description: à la fin de la phrase, un segment subdivisé par six petits traits verticaux, extrémités comprises ; sous le premier « $a_1$ », sous le deuxième « $a_2$ », puis un point et trois tirets, et sous le dernier « $a_n$ » ; une parenthèse fermante à droite.
drawings.notes: At the very bottom of the page, closing the sentence: a segment, rising slightly to the right, with six short vertical ticks (both ends included), placed on the line at computed points; under the first a_1, under the second a_2, then a dot and three short dashes under the following ticks, and a_n under the last; the closing parenthesis of the sentence to the right, kept because the transcription's mark names it. The subscript of the last label is read n after the text (a_1 < a_2 < ... < a_n). Nothing struck. Redrawn rather than encoded: a plain subdivided segment. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again.
